questiondescription.text:
Sets: regions of a three-set Venn diagram

Grade 12 CBE Core and Essential 1.1 (d): Describe sets built from three sets, and sets described in words, by listing their regions in a numbered three-set Venn diagram.

Core and Essential

This question is adapted from the revision exercise on page 220, question 6 of School Mathematics Project, SMP Book 3 (Metric), ed. A. G. Howson, Cambridge University Press, 1967: naming shaded regions of a three-set Venn diagram; region numbers make the region a typed set, every expression is new and a part in words is added.

INNODEMS CBC Grade 12 Mathematics, first draft by Ben Davies, 2026. Aligned to the KICD Senior School Curriculum Design, Core and Essential Mathematics Grade 12 (draft).
